scientific_integrity: Full proof with exact finite-boundary checker, classical Gauss/Hasse/Hoffman ingredients; no claim of independent audit or exhaustive literature priority.
scientific_limitations: Establishes sharp attainment iff p congruent one modulo four and p at least 29; does not determine optimal values when the universal coherence bound is strict; only prime dimensions at least five and five labelled erasures.
title: First five-erasure coherence saturation for prime-dimensional Alltop Gabor frames
